description: Fork of exp530 (matmul-free LUT-LM SOTA, 1.4731 @ 108.3M). ALL FOUR LUT modules (qk, v, out_proj, residual) swapped from TinyMultiHeadLut (FIXED canonical-coverage anchor pairs) to TrainableAnchorsMultiHeadLUT (LEARNABLE anchor pairs: per (table,bit) two softmax selectors over input dims, argmax-STE fwd / softmax bwd; then soft signs -> bitmatrix -> row-softmax-STE, same as the soft pipeline). Pure-PyTorch autograd + torch.compile; per-block gradient checkpointing keeps peak ~18.5GB at bs=16 (the autograd-native soft path retains the [B*T, n_tables, K] tensors that the TinyMHLut custom Function recomputed). Trainable anchors ADD ~21.8M params (n_tables*NAP*2*input_dim per module): ~130M total vs exp530's 108.3M -- NOT param-matched (the cost of trainable anchoring). LUT table weights stay on LION (sparse grad); the dense anchor_logits go on AdamW (anchor_lr). Same naps/tphs/optimizer/LR/steps as exp530. vs exp530 1.4731, exp513 1.4825.
